changes.summary: Compose publishable bundles from imported and locally authored skills.
changes.body: Combine raw skill directories, selected Skillbox bundles, and native skills under a destination bundle. Select incoming skills with pick/omit, and choose local installation independently from publication with the install list. Bundled offline guidance covers configuration, authoring, and customization.
breaking: The add command now requires add skills <source> <id> --path <directory> or add skillbox <source> <id> --bundle <bundle>.

Configuration now uses typed source contributions with destination ids and a separate install list. The version 2 Skillbox lock replaces the previous SDK-format lock; old tracking files are not migrated automatically.

adoption.text: Before upgrading a 0.2.x workspace, back up skillbox/config.json, skillbox/lock.json, authored sources, and installed skills including local edits. Recreate the source selections in an empty disposable workspace with the new add commands, verify the installed files, then cut over to the new configuration and version 2 lock. Keep any unrelated root skills-lock.json unchanged. Update scripts that use the old add syntax.

changes.summary: Pin Git sources and customize bundles with intent-backed patches.
changes.body: Git imports record immutable revisions and reuse a shared local cache. Ordinary sync retains pins. Prepare and capture per-skill patches with per-file intent; update stages an upstream candidate for review, capture accepts it, and sync installs it. Consumers receive producer patches and keep their own additional patches separately.

adoption.text: Use patch prepare <id>, patch capture <id> --from <workspace>, and update <id> for reviewed customization and updates. Commit patch.toml files and their changes payloads; ignore skillbox/.prepare/. Filesystem-path sources remain live authored worktrees rather than immutable Git pins.

changes.summary: Publish shared PSTACK workflows and a pinned deslop skill through the repository.
changes.body: Import the repository's pstack and deslop bundles with add skillbox codethread/skillbox workflows --bundle pstack --bundle deslop. Producer-owned workflow patches remain in the producer; consumer customizations remain consumer-owned. These bundles are distributed from Git, separately from the npm CLI.
Replace the Git dependency with the latest published npm version, retain local Markdown changelog generation, and verify release installation with the current add syntax.

changes.summary: Update the bundled cli-changelog dependency to 0.1.1.
changes.body: Bundles @codethread/cli-changelog@0.1.1 in the npm CLI and standalone executable.

Read release history offline with skillbox changelog. Select releases with --since or --release, page changes with --limit and --offset, request --schema, or opt into --text. The npm package includes CHANGELOG.md generated from the same history. Both the Node npm CLI and standalone binary are supported.

adoption.text: Run skillbox changelog --since 0.2.0 to read changes since your previous version. No tracking-file migration is required from 0.2.0.

changes.summary: Reconcile direct config edits during sync.
changes.body: Sync installs newly selected skills, removes deselected managed skills and lock entries, and preserves retained content hashes. Results report installed, unchanged and removed counts.

adoption.text: Edit skillbox/config.json and run sync. Both tracking files must already exist; use add for the first installation. Managed installed files are generated output and can be replaced or removed.

changes.summary: Bundle offline configuration and authoring guidance.
changes.body: Discover guidance with skills list, load instructions with skills get, retrieve supporting resources with skills file, and request response schemas with skills schema.
Migration guidance is manual; this does not add an automated migration command.

changes.summary: Expose the installed version with -v and --version.
Clarify source grouping, local bundles and npm execution options.
changes.body: Reuse the exact source string to merge bundle selections. Ignore generated .agents/skills/ and the .claude/skills symlink in consuming projects.
Store the SDK-format lock at skillbox/lock.json, preserve existing entries and workspace-relative source paths, and leave the root skills-lock.json owned by npx skills untouched.
breaking: Skillbox no longer reads its lock from the root skills-lock.json.

adoption.text: If Skillbox 0.1.0 created your root skills-lock.json, move it to skillbox/lock.json before upgrading. Do not move an unrelated npx skills lock; migration is not automatic.

changes.summary: Publish the repository-local skill bundle CLI under MIT.
changes.body: Install local or Git-hosted bundles with add, record source selections and SDK lock entries, and restore matching skill contents with sync. Includes workspace selection, JSON outcomes, a prebuilt npm CLI and a standalone binary. Lock hashes check content; immutable revision replay, shared caching, updates and patches are not implemented.
